# Add clamp

## ID
0001

## Sprint
Backlog

## Priority
P1

## Status
🔲 Backlog

## Owner
fkit-coder

## Requirements
Add a named clamp(value,lower,upper) export for finite numbers with lower <= upper. Return lower below the range, upper above it, and the original value inside inclusive bounds. Preserve add/subtract. Equal bounds, negatives, fractions and signed zero inside the inclusive range must work. Invalid/nonfinite inputs and reversed bounds are outside scope.

## Verification steps
1. Extend existing check.mjs, preserving six arithmetic checks and updating export expectations; cover below/inside/above, both endpoints, equal bounds, negatives, fractions and signed zero. Run node check.mjs. No new test files/dependencies.
2. Approved plan persisted separately from one approval-time plan-review attempt; unchanged project inventory before approval. All form decisions labeled SYNTHETIC.
3. Actual independent/stateful review with usable fresh adversarial; ledger closed; plan-review mode carried into evidence.
4. Actual producer alone invokes fkit-task-done, retaining artifacts and matching agent-closed—not-owner-verified status/hrefs.

## Scope
Use actual fkit-task-ship-loop: plan first, wait at the actual form. A SYNTHETIC operator approval authorizes the bounded fixture build→verify→review→producer closure, not human UI acceptance. Only sample.mjs/check.mjs, authorized task records and this fixture board lifecycle may change. No real-checkout edits, commits/pushes/releases, wiki writes or sprint closure.

## Notes
- **Depends on:** nothing
